title: fix(plugin-form): a headingless section's `description` renders in the grouped layout
body:
Fixes #9835

Clause-②: no — verified against this diff, ⛔ not inherited from the claim. No new exported symbol; the blurb-only row reuses existing `FormField` keys (`name`, `type`, `description`) and adds no key to any published payload or authorable surface.

## The ruling this implements

Maintainer ruling 2026-09-18, **letter B** (director seat comment on the card; maintainer 「同意」). Quoted verbatim, ⛔ not translated:

> Grouped layout: a member with `description` and no title renders its blurb through a path that carries nothing else — ⛔ no `visibleWhen` gating of the group, ⛔ no collapse — matching what the other four arms show. The `if (label)` gate and its three riders are unchanged.

⛔ Letter **A** (widening the heading gate to `label || section.description`) was refused and is ⛔ not re-opened here: that one condition also carries the ADR-0089 `visibleWhen` predicate row, objectui#6236's membership claim that gates the whole group, and the `collapsed` / `collapsible` pair whose "an untitled bucket is never collapsible" rule it implements.

## What changed

`packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` — the grouped (default) branch gains an `else if` beside the heading-gated divider push. A member that authored a `description` and neither `name` nor `label` now takes a **blurb-only** row carrying the `description` and nothing else: no `label`, no `visibleWhen`, no `fields` membership claim, no `collapsed` / `collapsible` / `onToggle`, and no `colSpan` (the renderer returns a divider before it reaches the grid-span wrapper, and `SectionDivider` spans the row itself). The `if (label)` gate is byte-for-byte unchanged, and so is the collapse branch below it, which stays keyed on `label`.

The comment that asserted the OLD behaviour — the one stating the shape "still draws no divider and still drops its blurb … handed back as a finding" — is rewritten in the same change rather than left asserting a fact this PR falsifies.

⚠️ **回翻条款 — not triggered.** None of the three declared semantics moved. The predicate row, the membership claim and the collapse pair are all still reached only through `if (label)`; the new branch copies none of them. This is verified behaviourally by rows 8 and 9 below, not by reading the diff.

## The flipped pin, and what each row proves separately

`packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormSectionMembers-8071.test.tsx` — the pin PR objectui#9833 added is the one that flips. ⛔ A single "something rendered" assertion would have been satisfied by the refused letter A, so each half is its own row with its own lit control:

| row | claim | lit control on the same instrument and corpus |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | the blurb **is** rendered, and **no divider heading** comes with it | the same member with a `label` added draws a heading |
| 8 | **no collapse control**, and `collapsed: true` does **not** remove the fields | the titled twin draws the control and loses its fields |
| 9 | an authored `visibleWhen` **gates nothing** — blurb and field both stay | the titled twin under the DENYING scope loses heading, blurb and field; under the ADMITTING scope gets all three back |
| 10 | ⭐ cross-arm guard: `split` / `modal` / `wizard` / `tabbed` still render a headingless member's blurb | per-arm absence control — the same mount with no `description` reports none |

Row 10 is why a future edit cannot "make the arms agree" by breaking the four instead of keeping the fifth. Each arm is read at its own chrome (the stacked arms at the `SectionDivider` row, the wizard at its step container, the tabbed arm in its tab panel), ⛔ never through `textContent`.

## Reverse verification — four ablations, each with on-disk proof and a proven restore

Run through `ablation-replace`, which asserts the anchor hit count, the blob hash change, and — on the restore leg — `blob == HEAD` plus an empty `git diff HEAD`. Every leg restored cleanly; the working tree is clean.

| mutation | expected | observed |
|---|---|---|
| the new `else if` branch disabled | rows 7, 8, 9 red | 3 failed / 7 passed — each on `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'Totals as invoiced' ]` |
| the heading gate widened to letter **A** | rows 8, 9 red, row 7 green | 2 failed / 8 passed — row 8 on `expected 1 to be +0` (a collapse control appeared), row 9 on `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'amount' ]` (the group got gated) |
| the `split` arm's blurb copy removed | row 10 red | 1 failed / 9 passed, naming `split` |
| the `tabbed` arm's blurb copy removed | row 10 red | 1 failed / 9 passed, naming `tabbed` |

⭐ The second row is the load-bearing one: it shows rows 8 and 9 catch exactly the design the maintainer refused, which row 7 alone cannot distinguish from the ruled one.

## Tests — all read at `5ea3899ada` (the final commit)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/` — **Test Files 100 passed (100) · Tests 943 passed | 1 skipped (944)**. Run through the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` — exit 0 (both `tsc --noEmit` and the test tsconfig, so the new pin rows compile). Preceded by `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build`, because a stale `dist/*.d.ts` lies in both directions.
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` — **199 passed**, and that file is ⛔ **unedited** (it is held by open PR objectui#9924). A behaviour flip did not move the ledger's counts, as the order predicted.
- Gates: `check:control-bytes` (exit 0), `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset for 2 published source files), `check-changeset-no-major` — all exit 0. Every exit code captured to disk **before** any pipe.
- Control-character sweep over the three changed files: `grep -naP` over the control ranges, no match.

**Declared narrowing.** `eslint` was run over the two changed files only (`--no-inline-config`; `--format json` reports **2 files linted, 0 errors, 64 warnings**, all `no-explicit-any` matching the files' existing style). The repo-wide run belongs to CI. The narrowing is sound because `eslint.config.js` declares no `projectService`, no `project` and no `parserOptions` — type-aware linting is not enabled, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- `drawerFormSectionDescription-9834`'s row 5 carries a contrastive aside — that the drawer's ungated push renders a headingless blurb "unlike the default arm". Its assertion is about the drawer only and stays green; the sentence also stays literally true, because the default arm still draws no divider heading for that member. It is simply less contrastive now that the default arm renders the blurb by another route. ⛔ Not filed, ⛔ not edited (outside this card's file surface). Successor: the next change that touches that pin.
- `SplitForm` and `ModalForm` spell their gate `label || description` — the letter-A shape on their own arms, where it carries different riders. ⛔ Not a finding and ⛔ not filed: the ruling left those arms alone on purpose.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 默认(grouped)表单布局里,一个只写了 `description`、没有 `name` 也没有 `label` 的 section,以前什么都不显示;现在它的说明文字会显示出来。

**为什么改** — 另外四种布局(split / modal / wizard / tabbed)一直都显示它,只有默认布局不显示。同一份元数据,换个布局就看不见了。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险很低:新增的那一行只携带说明文字,不携带谓词、不携带折叠、不携带分组归属,所以 `visibleWhen` 与 `collapsed` 的运行时语义一个字节都没动(这一点由两条独立的钉子分别验证,不是靠读 diff)。回滚就是删掉那个 `else if` 分支,钉子会立刻变红并指明原因。

**席位意见** — (留空,待认领席定稿)

**你要做的** — 不需要做什么;这是一条行为一致性修复。若你希望无标题 section 干脆不该有说明文字(原卡的 C 案),请说一声,那需要另一张卡。
